jsonld.headline: Supriyo B Chatterjee  was one of the first people who sat down with me and took Splita seriously, the pitches, the strategy, all of it.
jsonld.articleBody:
Supriyo B Chatterjee  was one of the first people who sat down with me and took Splita seriously, the pitches, the strategy, all of it. That kind of investment in someone early on changes how you see yourself.

That kind of guidance sticks with you. So when Trinity’s Summit-to-Success program reached out asking me to mentor incoming students this fall, it only felt right to do so. 

S2S is a mentorship and orientation program supporting incoming students as they navigate college life. I’ll be working directly with new scholars, leading training, and helping build community from day one.

Can’t wait to be that person for someone else.
Trinity College-Hartford Supriyo B Chatterjee Roberta Rogers
